**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Invalidate ticket-backed reports when revisions change**

At reviewed head `57ac3036cb82fd096bc98ba8b015aedb48afbc76`, when a full report is displayed in the standalone `?source=` window, `request.current` is null because that window never initiated `clinical:open`. A later `clinical:activity` for the same object with a newer version or withdrawal therefore bypasses the request-key cleanup, while the report stored here continues rendering obsolete full rows indefinitely; invalidate `source` and `sourceLabReport` against subsequent activity/snapshot identity and version changes in ticket-backed windows too.

AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L63-L63](https://github.com/peterkis/light-island/blob/57ac3036cb82fd096bc98ba8b015aedb48afbc76/AGENTS.md#L63-L63)
